mechanism_description: When Required Run Rate escalates into extreme crisis states (RRR >= 16.0 with 2-4 wickets in hand), the raw DLI calculation exceeds 5.00 and is clamped to 5.00. Consequently, a scenario requiring 22 off 6 receives the exact same leverage index as an impossible scenario requiring 45 off 6.
effect_on_player_evaluation: Under-differentiates bowler economy difficulty in desperate death defenses; bowlers conceding 15 runs in a 40-run buffer receive the same extreme-pressure credit as bowlers defending 10 runs.
recommended_research_direction: Investigate Win Probability Leverage Index (WPLI) or non-linear logistical compression (sigmoid) that incorporates match hopelessness and distinguishes high leverage from dead rubber chase states.

issue_title: Fixed Phase Par Independence from Pitch & Scoring Environment
affected_regime: Chase and Setting Innings - High/Low Scoring Venues
example_delivery: Match 31248 (SRH 287 vs RCB 262) vs Match 46311 (Low-scoring spin track)
mechanism_description: DLI relies on static tournament-wide phase par run rates (PP: 7.50, Mid: 8.00, Death: 10.00). On a 230-run pitch (Chinnaswamy), a required rate of 10.0 is par, yet DLI registers elevated pressure (1.25). Conversely, on a 130-run pitch (Chepauk/Lucknow), an 8.50 RRR represents extreme difficulty, yet DLI classifies it as Tier 2.
effect_on_player_evaluation: May slightly over-credit batters performing on high-scoring roads and under-credit batters executing disciplined chases on deteriorating, low-scoring wickets.
recommended_research_direction: Incorporate match-level expected score (e.g. innings 1 target as venue proxy, or rolling venue par) into phase baselines.

issue_title: Over 1 Undefined Run Rate in Setting Innings
mechanism_description: In Over 1 of target setting, CRR is undefined (balls bowled < 6). The formula defaults stagnation to zero, producing a baseline leverage around 0.75-0.85. If 2 wickets fall in Over 1, leverage rises via W_hand (to ~1.15), but does not reflect early collapse scoring stagnation.
effect_on_player_evaluation: Mildly dampens pressure ratings for Top Order openers facing hostile opening spells with early wicket losses.
recommended_research_direction: Define Bayesian prior for Over 1 par scoring (e.g. 6.0 runs/over) to enable smooth stagnation scoring from ball 1.

issue_title: Invariant Constant Leverage Pinning for Super Overs
example_delivery: Match 40725 Innings 3 & 4 (All 10 balls pinned to DLI = 3.50)
mechanism_description: All 26 Super Over deliveries are pinned to constant DLI = 3.50, Tier 4: Extreme. This treats ball 1 of a super over identically to ball 6 of a super over chase where 3 runs are required.
effect_on_player_evaluation: Negligible on player career volume (26 total deliveries out of 179,837), but theoretically static.
recommended_research_direction: Preserve current static assignment for simplicity given ultra-low sample volume (0.014% of deliveries).

mechanism_description: In the final over, the hyperbolic runway term (1 + 24/(B_rem + 12))^0.5 flattens into an asymptote (varying only between 1.53 and 1.69). As a result, ball-by-ball leverage swings in the 20th over are almost entirely proportional to the remaining run deficit rather than a discrete step penalty for balls expiring.
effect_on_player_evaluation: Slightly softens the exponential pressure surge expected on balls 119 and 120 of a tight chase.
recommended_research_direction: Calibrate terminal runway exponent or evaluate piecewise final-over multiplier.

issue_title: High Leverage Elasticity at Extreme Tail (W_hand <= 2)
affected_regime: Setting and Chase - Innings Tails (8-9 wickets down)
mechanism_description: When a team loses 8 or 9 wickets, the scarcity factor (10/(W_hand+1))^0.6 reaches 2.76, pushing setting DLI to its maximum clamp ceiling (3.50) even if the innings is only in Over 14. This means lower-order tailenders batting in hopeless collapse states are automatically classified into Tier 4: Extreme.
effect_on_player_evaluation: Numbers 10 and 11 receive high-pressure sample volume for simply batting during an inevitable rout.
recommended_research_direction: Incorporate expected tail resource degradation or evaluate role-specific leverage qualification.
